title: Lincoln Memorial Statue, Washington D.C. B&W Snapshot 1949
back_text_transcription:
Lincoln Memorial
Washington D. C.
June 4, 5, 1949
description: A vintage black and white snapshot capturing Daniel Chester French's iconic marble statue of Abraham Lincoln inside the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C. Above the statue, the famous inscription wall text is visible. The reverse features handwritten blue ink noting the location and dates of June 4–5, 1949.
